Title: Ju-on: The Beginning of the End
Writer: Masayuki Ochiai, Takashige Ichise, Takashi Shimizu
Actors: Shô Aoyagi, Yoshihiko Hakamada, Yasuhito Hida
Plot: A school teacher visits the home of a boy who's been absent from school for a long period of time, unaware of the horrific tragedy which occurred in the boy's household many years ago.
